options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG       Path to remote_train.yaml
  --provider {mock,vastai}
                        Compute provider
  --gpu GPU             GPU name substring filter (e.g. A100)
  --min-vram MIN_VRAM   Minimum GPU VRAM in GB
  --disk DISK           Minimum/requested disk in GB (must hold model weights)
  --max-price MAX_PRICE
                        Max $/hr cap
  --max-hours MAX_HOURS
                        Max wall-clock hours (teardown watchdog)
  --verbose             Debug logging
  --rl-config RL_CONFIG
                        RL run config (default rl_config.yaml)
  --adapter ADAPTER     LoRA adapter dir to serve on top of the base (e.g.
                        output)
  --for-seconds FOR_SECONDS
                        Auto-stop after N seconds (0 = until Ctrl-C)
